decisions.reason: The source specifies the platform's beige and font colors; it does not change the machine branding wording, placard placement, or placard sides.
Matching the platform colors to the machine does not change the existing DJ-turntable-inspired visual identity.
The source changes platform colors only and does not alter spout geometry, construction, orientation, or beverage-quality constraints.
The platform color decision does not alter bowl capacity, depth, size, or form.
The platform's functional configuration and cup-clearance purpose remain unchanged; its color treatment is independently owned by the color-scheme Requirement.
The source does not change the system-layout deliverable, its required completion state, or the adopted overall design direction.
Platform and font colors have no effect on splash targets or high-speed splash-control measures.
The source does not change any sealing, leak-prevention, or liquid-containment behavior.
The platform color decision does not change the finalized wiring-plan deliverable.
The source does not alter mixing quality, foam, texture, or high-speed mixing behavior.
Matching platform and font colors does not change the V1 sourcing policy or rapid-prototype priority.
The source does not alter the valve mechanism, gravity-based dispensing, operation sequence, or controlled-flow behavior.
